lastCompletedStory.title: cam-plan: replace the MVP-vs-launch-ready fork with one proportional plan that reads the grilled spec

nextStoryContext: US-002 removed the MVP-vs-launch-ready fork from Step 6 of cam-plan and replaced it with a single proportional plan driven by the grilled spec. The Step 7 planner prompt now passes 'Grilled spec' (settled scope) instead of 'Scope approved by operator: MVP/Launch-ready'. Both .claude and templates copies were updated and the embedded _generated.ts was re-synced. US-003 edits subagent-planner.md (both copies) to add vertical-slice decomposition and remove requires:operator story emission.
